purpose: One admission record per third-party component this build links, runs on, or is packaged by. Every field is copied from a file in this repository or from the crate's own published source in the local cargo registry; a component whose licence text cannot be read from a file here carries noticeText null and needsReview true, and the credits page says its notice is pending rather than inventing one.

buildOnlyPackages.name: gdextension-api
buildOnlyPackages.reason: godot-bindings reads the pinned GDExtension API JSON at build time; no code from it is linked.

buildOnlyPackages.name: godot-bindings
buildOnlyPackages.reason: build-dependency of godot-ffi: locates the engine API and drives codegen.

buildOnlyPackages.name: godot-codegen
buildOnlyPackages.reason: build-dependency of godot-core: generates the binding source that is then compiled.

buildOnlyPackages.name: heck
buildOnlyPackages.reason: build-dependency of godot-codegen: case conversion for generated identifiers.

buildOnlyPackages.name: nanoserde
buildOnlyPackages.reason: build-dependency of godot-codegen: parses the GDExtension API JSON at build time.

buildOnlyPackages.name: nanoserde-derive
buildOnlyPackages.reason: proc-macro of nanoserde, build side only.

components.name: Godot Engine
components.reviewNote: The pinned artefact is the published Linux binary zip (Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip), which contains the executable and nothing else: no LICENSE.txt, no COPYRIGHT.txt. The engine's notice and its third-party copyright list are inside the source tree, which is not in this repository and not readable here, so nothing is copied. The MIT identifier and the URL come from the pinned release, not from memory.

components.name: Godot Engine export templates
components.reviewNote: Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz is the engine built for each target platform, so an exported build ships it and owes its notice. The .tpz carries templates only; the licence text is not in it and is not readable here.

components.name: Mesa (mesa-vulkan-drivers, lavapipe)
components.reviewNote: The capture job installs mesa-vulkan-drivers from the runner's apt archive with no version pin, so this repository pins no version and states none. Mesa renders the CI captures and is not distributed with the game; it is recorded because the CI plate names it, not because a build ships it.
